nodes.name: cli_monte_carlo.yaml
nodes.summary: Hydra base config for the Monte Carlo analysis CLI (analytics/cli/cli_monte_carlo_hydra.py). Supplies scenario path, output dir, trial count (10000) and random seed (42); stochastic distributions are read from the scenario's monte_carlo block, not here.

nodes.name: cli_sensitivity.yaml
nodes.summary: Hydra base config for the sensitivity analysis CLI (analytics/cli/cli_sensitivity_hydra.py). Provides scenario path, output dir and the tornado target metrics list (project_irr); parameter ranges are derived by the sensitivity_runner engine.

nodes.name: run_full_pipeline_v14.yaml
nodes.summary: Hydra base config for run_full_pipeline_v14.py driving the end-to-end finance evaluation: schema validation mode, artifact export dir, and the Sprint-19 wind to finance integration knobs (frozen wind-export JSON path, auto-orchestrate, adapter merge mode, drift tolerance, P-level scenario).

nodes.name: run_scenario_analytics_v14.yaml
nodes.summary: Primary Hydra config for the v14 scenario analytics runner: scenarios directory, Excel/JSON output paths, strict schema-guard, parallel toggle, chart export, name filter and default discount rate (0.12), with Hydra runtime settings to keep the working directory stable.

nodes.name: scanner.yaml
nodes.summary: Hydra config for the Dolphin D01 repository scanner (Sprint 18 / GWTF ARCH-01 config-first compliance), setting the repo root to scan and the reports output directory.

nodes.name: scenario_analytics_v14.yaml
nodes.summary: Base config for v14 scenario analytics: scenarios directory, Excel output path, no-excel/charts toggles, strict schema-guard, parallel processing toggle, optional name filter, batch default discount rate and optional JSON summary output.

nodes.name: wind_analysis.yaml
nodes.summary: Hydra config for run_wind_analysis_v14.py, the complete wind-resource assessment: location, ERA5 date range, 150m hub height, turbine model (envision_en171_6p5), 15-turbine farm, cache/output dirs and the P75 lender base-case export scenario.

nodes.name: wind_download.yaml
nodes.summary: Hydra config for run_wind_download_v14.py, which downloads ERA5 reanalysis wind data and extrapolates it to hub height: location, date range, 150m hub height, force-download flag and cache/output directories.
